# IntechOpen

> > IntechOpen is a peer-reviewed open-access publisher specializing in digital medicine, healthcare technology, and critical care innovation.

IntechOpen publishes cutting-edge research on digital health transformation, medical devices, and clinical case studies. The platform features contributions from leading researchers and clinicians advancing healthcare through technology and digital innovation.

## Key Topics

- Digital Medicine
- Healthcare Technology
- Digital-ICU Technology
- Critical Care
- Medical Devices
- Peer-Reviewed Research
- Adolescent Care
- Case Reports
- IntechOpen
- Clinical Innovation
- Health Technology Assessment
- Patient Care Systems

## Digital Medicine & Healthcare Technology

- [Digital Medicine and Healthcare Technology | IntechOpen](https://www.intechopen.com/journals/4): IntechOpen journal on digital medicine and healthcare technology innovation, featuring peer-reviewed research on digital transformation in clinical practice and critical care systems
